patthana19.4:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana19.4:2.1: na anupādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, pañca.
patthana19.4:3.1: na anupādinna anupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana19.4:4.1: na upādinnupādāniyañca na anupādinna anupādāniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana19.4:5.1: na anupādinnupādāniyañca na anupādinna anupādāniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādinnupādāniyo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana19.4:6.1: na upādinnupādāniyañca na anupādinnupādāniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinna anupādāniyo dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
